CapyPanel's copy of pyte
========================

pyte 0.8.2 (https://github.com/selectel/pyte), the files of its 0.8.2 release, under its own
license, the LGPL-3.0 (LICENSE, the same text as CapyPanel's licenses/lgpl-3.0.txt). Its authors
are in AUTHORS. CapyPanel's terminal runs on it: it reads what ssh.exe prints, and CapyPanel's
own code (capypanel/core/ssh/screen.py) builds on its Screen and ByteStream.

What CapyPanel changed, and when:

2026-11-18
- screens.py: the character widths come from _widths.py instead of the wcwidth package, so no
  other package joins CapyPanel. The import line and the module's notice say so.
- _widths.py: new. wcwidth's answers from Python's own Unicode tables (see its notice).
- Left out: __main__.py (pyte's command-line demo) and py.typed.

Every other file is as released. Fixes for what pyte gets wrong live in CapyPanel's own code
(capypanel/core/ssh/screen.py), each with its reason, so they can go back to pyte's authors.
